name: WaterproofCap-Bench
description: "This dataset releases the complete evaluation artifacts of WaterproofCap-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for aspect-ratio (AR) stratified evaluation of industrial defect detectors. It contains COCO-format annotations (v2 canonical train\/val\/test splits with per-instance AR and bin labels, plus the pre-dedup v1 test annotations), frozen detection predictions for every reported run (3 architectures \u2014 RT-DETRv2, Cascade R-CNN, YOLOv8-L \u2014 across 10 independently seeded runs on WaterproofCap-Bench, 3 runs on NEU-DET, and single-seed runs on PCB, Severstal, and KolektorSDD2), the full AR-stratified evaluation and analysis code, all training configurations with fixed seeds, and 40 final model checkpoints. Every reported number in the associated paper is exactly reproducible by running the included evaluator on the released predictions. Raw inspection images are proprietary industrial data, available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request."
